title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on John 11: the death and raising of Lazarus.

questions.text: Whom did Jesus raise from the dead in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Jesus called Lazarus out of the tomb after he had been dead four days.

questions.text: Who were the sisters of Lazarus?
questions.explanation: Mary and Martha lived in Bethany with their brother Lazarus.

questions.text: Which village did Lazarus come from?
questions.explanation: Lazarus was from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.

questions.text: How long had Lazarus been in the tomb when Jesus arrived?
questions.explanation: Jesus found that Lazarus had been in the tomb four days already.

questions.text: What is the shortest verse in the Bible, found in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Seeing the grief of Mary and those with her, Jesus wept.

questions.text: What did Jesus say to Martha about himself?
questions.explanation: Jesus said, "I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me, though he die, yet will he live."

answers.text: "I am the resurrection and the life."

questions.text: What closed the entrance of the tomb?
questions.explanation: The tomb was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

questions.text: What did Martha object when Jesus asked to take away the stone?
questions.explanation: Martha said, "Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days."

answers.text: That the stone was too heavy
That he had been dead four days
That the tomb was not theirs

questions.text: What did Jesus cry out with a loud voice at the tomb?
questions.explanation: Jesus cried with a loud voice, "Lazarus, come out!"

questions.text: How was Lazarus dressed when he came out?
questions.explanation: He came out bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped with a cloth.

answers.text: In grave clothes, with his face wrapped
In a clean white linen robe
In the garments of a king
In the clothes he had worn in life
